questions.decision: Whether #783 (second lesson review, 34 scored lessons) is a reused child of this Goal Run or stays a standalone issue outside it

options.summary: Reuse #783 as slice 3; slices 1 and 2 land the mechanisms its top candidates graduate onto
options.tradeoff: One cursor for review and mechanisms; the review's length sits inside the run

options.summary: Keep #783 outside; the goal holds only the three follow-ups
options.tradeoff: Shorter run; the review must track by hand which mechanism landed in which commit

recommendation.reason: The ordering 'mechanism before the lesson it graduates' only exists inside one run

options.summary: Routing mechanism in-goal; 8.0.3 cut in slice 5 only on explicit operator authorization at that moment
options.tradeoff: The slice may close as 'routing landed, release deferred with reason'

questions.decision: Mode of the first cross-key sweep of charness/runtime/ (1,871 keys, 340 GB)

options.summary: Report mode first; the operator reads the report; the deleting sweep applies only the existing dead-key rule
options.tradeoff: One extra step before space is reclaimed

options.summary: Run the deleting sweep directly under the dead-key rule already documented for pytest-tmp
options.tradeoff: Faster; the first run deletes hundreds of GB nobody has looked at

recommendation.reason: Deletion at this scale is irreversible and the rule was written for a much smaller tree
